title: Stabilize canonical repo control files
notes: docs/spec/spec.md, docs/spec/checklist.json, docs/spec/update_history, and README.md are aligned with the implemented Python package and Markdown update_history format.

title: Implement discovery and deterministic parsing
notes: Implemented host-aware target resolution, ecosystem detection, SKILL.md parsing, Codex openai.yaml parsing, and explicit HOST_ECOSYSTEM_UNKNOWN handling backed by fixture tests.

title: Implement secret, privacy, and suspicious execution detection
notes: Implemented deterministic hard-fail detection for likely secrets, private keys, password assignments, curl/wget pipe-to-shell, and opaque temp/cache binary execution patterns.

title: Implement runtime state writes and report generation
notes: Implemented ordered state writes for audit run snapshots, per-instance ledgers, skill index, clusters, active set, and text/json/markdown reporting. Ledger note preservation and append-only change_log are covered by tests.

title: Implement watch mode and git hook gate
notes: Implemented watch session fingerprint skipping, skill ownership mapping, polling-based watch loop with SIGINT/SIGTERM handling, hook installer, and deterministic-only git hook gating.

title: Implement clustering, heuristic analysis, and active-set recommendation
notes: Implemented duplicate-instance clustering by skill_key, lexical overlap heuristic findings, deterministic/heuristic separation, and CLI-driven active-set cap enforcement through --active-set-max.

title: Keep the auditor directly usable in Codex and Claude Code without external API setup
notes: The implemented CLI does not expose standalone API key or endpoint configuration; semantic analysis currently degrades to skipped while deterministic audit remains host-native and local-only.

title: Add contextual line-level detail to findings and remediation suggestions
notes: Finding model extended with line_number and matched_text. Rules now capture source line and code snippet. Remediation suggestions output structured what/how with file path, line number, and step-by-step fix guidance instead of generic template sentences.

title: Implement git_clone, local_repo, and builtin source detection and source_kind classification
notes: _detect_git_source() walks up from skill dir to find .git, parses .git/config for remote origin URL, detects builtin skills via .system directory markers. classify_source_kind() extended with builtin, git_clone, local_repo.

title: Implement batch edit operations (tag, note, protect, allow-rule) for ledger entries
notes: batch.py module with batch_edit(). Operations are ledger-layer only. Builtin sources auto-skipped; git_clone sync_protected skipped unless --include-protected.

title: Implement source list, register, and detect CLI commands
notes: skill-auditor source list|register|detect commands. sources.py provides detect_all_sources(), register_source(), list_sources().

title: Implement GitHub source upgrade check and apply flow with temp-clone diff
notes: upgrade.py implements check_upgrades() and apply_upgrade(). Never modifies tags/note/rule_exceptions/sync_protected.

title: Implement per-skill rule exception allowlisting in validation and audit
notes: rules.validate_instance() accepts rule_exceptions; security.* rules never suppressed. engine.run_audit() loads from ledger.

title: Implement sync_protected flag and anti-overwrite protection
notes: sync_protected defaults true for git_clone. Builtin/plugin_marketplace/plugin_cache auto-skipped in batch. Upgrade preserves all annotations.
